notes.title: OhShape Ultimate - Power Up Update, New Fitness Album!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This year is the 5th anniversary of the release of OhShape, how time flies!

OhShape, our first game, holds a special place in our hearts. But it's not just us who've shaped it; it's you, our incredible community, who've been with us every step of the way, offering your support and insights. You are the ones who've made OhShape what it is today, and we owe a great deal of our success to you!

That's why we want to give back some of this love. We introduce you to the…

🤸 OhShape Ultimate: POWER UP Update! 🤸

- 🏋️ New free Power Up album with six songs and two difficulty levels!

Endure these hard sessions and get an intense workout while having fun. Are you up to the challenge?

- 🌃 New environment

A vibrant, futuristic city directly taken from a cyberpunk setting

- 🤗  OhShape Ultimate for everyone!

Now, all the platforms will receive the OhShape Ultimate treatment! Enjoy OhShape Ultimate (better UI and visuals, Electro Party album, and more!) in Meta Quest, PICO, and Steam VR! (the PSVR2 version is in the oven and will be ready very soon!)

And the surprises keep coming! To celebrate the 5th anniversary, we are planning to hold **exciting monthly challenges** and fun contests with amazing prizes! **Get ready to show off your skills and win big!**

Stay tuned because we are back and stronger than ever!

notes.title: OhShape v.1.9.68 - Flow Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

At OhShape we have keep working on improving the feeling of the game, and here are some Quality of Life improvements requested by our community in the past months:

-Better feeling when you pass through the walls: some people had the feeling they could hit their head with the top of the silhouettes even when the calibration was set on point. To reduce this sensation, we have added a fading effect that feels way better when you play.

-Auto-recentering tweak: some time ago, we made adjustments to improve the synchronisation between the sounds of objects and music. This system worked as intented, slightly pushing the center of the game as you move around. However, there was a problem for people playing in small spaces: they could end up outside the boundaries of the guardian area without realising it. We have changed this: now the floor is fixated to the same position but the objects still follow the player, allowing the sync benefits of that system without the risk of getting carried away and leaving the guardian area.

-More natural hand position: instead of showing the hands with outstretched fingers, the hands now have a half-closed position more reminiscent of hands holding controllers.

-More satisfying coin FXs: now when you grab a golden coin, it explodes with a flash and a particle trail. The previous system could be confusing for newcomers because they didn't know whether they were doing it right or not.
This is all for today, keep an eye on future updates since we are going to add a new feature soon! :)

On top of that, our Electro Party DLC owners will receive a free update with a new song: 'Show Me' by Tiësto.

notes.title: OhShape v 1.5.3 - Ice Planet Update is out now!
notes.notes:
About one year ago on August 15, 2020, OhShape was released as an Early Access on Steam! During this time OhShape has grown with the updates and improvements thanks to the support and feedback from the community.

Aligned with this anniversary, we have been working in our Ice Planet update with content and features requested by players:

-New environment: a refreshing new stage based on an ice planet world. It will be the first of many more to come!

-Achievements: the most competitive players can now brag about their progress in the game with 20 achievements covering different difficulties, scores, playtime, distance covered...

-3 new songs: we have added 3 free songs to the third OhShape album, having a total of 31 official maps

-New onboarding screen: we now welcome new players more clearly and directly to make the first experience a very rewarding one!


We are very happy with the current state of OhShape, but we still have a lot of aces up our sleeves! More content, more features, customization and a few collaborations lined up for the next year makes us look forward to showing you all of it!

notes.title: Delight-ful Update! v 1.3.5
notes.notes:
OhShape and Synth Riders walk together! We have joined forces with Kluge Interactive to make an unprecedent collaboration inside the VR rhythm genre: both games now feature a free content update with the map 'Delight'. Composed by Jamie Berry and with the lyrics of Octavia Rose, this electro swing hit will get you moving through walls and retro futuristic landscapes. Our devs have been working side by side to get fun and nice looking maps that flow smoothly in both games. Take a sneak peek in our trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_WMFKXb8HJ0

These are the release notes:

—————————————————————
- Added the Delight album & song by Jamie Berry
- Coin pop-corn sound removed (as requested by the OhShape community!)

notes.title: OhShape Party Mode Update is here!
notes.notes:
We've swept through all the recent feedback received from our community and we have covered some key elements highly requested by players. The new Party Mode will allow you to make quick local leaderboards with family and friends while the Practice Mode will let you repeat on loop any section of any map while you play around with different settings. You will overcome every map!

We have also polished visual aspects like the UI (way more clear and clean now) and the gems (now they have new physics and FX, they are way more fun to grab!). New sound FX, 4 new songs, personal leaderboards and more stuff were added to this big update! Take a look into the full list of release notes:

Here is the new update! Thanks everyone for making it possible! We have tackled the most demanded features by our community.
Between these new features we have 2 new songs (Not Boring and Funky Groove) that cover two beloved music genres: electro and, well, funky.
A new tutorial will welcome newcomers with all the basics.
Some walls have been reworked to be more intuitive (no more problems while ducking!).
Autocallibration has been upgraded as well as other aesthetic and sound improvements.
We hope you like these additions as we work on the next update, one that will bring a really big and tasy feature ;)
